unlisted_practices: Domain-specific training of LLMs on clinician-annotated datasets for medication tasks

screen.reason: Evaluates the raw performance and accuracy of GPT-4o on three basic medication management tasks (formulation matching, DDI identification, order generation) using standard metrics and clinician review of outputs without testing a specific deployment safeguard.
